student_questions.CLARIFY_REFERENCE: lists the legal referents (ids r1.. with kind + producing step); teacher replies REFERENT: <id> | NONE; a valid id becomes reference_choice={chosen, offered}: the other offered results are hidden from THIS slot's grounding (renamed kind HIDDEN_BY_REFERENCE_CHOICE; numbering unchanged)
student_questions.RESTATE_SLOT: step k + registered reason (incl. PREMATURE_TERMINAL_ACTION, UNREQUESTED_RETURN, UNNAMED_CALL, RELATION_LOCATION_ERROR legality fact, MISSING_ARGUMENT); teacher replies replacement STEP lines or CANCEL_SLOT
student_questions.RESTATE_OBSCURED: step k was obscured by the evaluator (never attributed to the teacher); teacher restates the action of step k
student_questions.MISSING_EXAMPLE: no step has run; teacher replies EXAMPLE: p=v, ...

grounder_retry: hosted grounder: one retry of the SAME line after structured rejection (same slot; feedback = legality facts only, never gold)
scripted_teacher_lookup: MISSING_EXAMPLE: its EXAMPLE; RESTATE*: its registered band-A rephrase of lesson line k; CLARIFY_REFERENCE: the result variable its registered gold unit for line k reads
